=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml: (code reference: The `triage-workflow-run.if` condition uses `!startsWith(github.event.workflow_run.name, 'AI ')` together with `on.workflow_run.workflows: ["*"]`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The `AI ` prefix is intended to identify pipeline-owned wrappers (e.g., `AI Review`, `AI Implement`), but the condition matches the prefix against any workflow name. A consumer-owned workflow whose name happens to start with `AI ` (e.g., `AI Integration Tests`, `AI Compliance Check`) would be matched by the wildcard trigger but then skipped by the job condition, so its failure is never triaged. The PR description claims the filter skips "the pipeline's own `AI …` workflows" but the implementation only filters by a textual prefix.
  WHY: The trigger fires for every completed workflow (per the `workflows: ["*"]` pattern), and any consumer workflow whose display name starts with `AI ` exits the `triage-workflow-run` job with no triage issue. The intended "triage consumer failures" coverage has a gap that a consumer cannot detect from the wrapper contract alone.
- workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml: (code reference: `on.workflow_run.workflows: ["*"]` together with the `triage-workflow-run` job) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The wildcard `workflows: ["*"]` matches completed runs of `AI Check Failure Triage` itself. Each wrapper run started by `workflow_run` completes and re-triggers the wildcard, creating a chain of skipped wrapper runs (one per upstream run, multiplied by chain length) rather than exactly one skipped wrapper run per upstream workflow.
  WHY: After any failed `CI` run, the auto-triage wrapper fires, completes, and its `completed` event matches the same wildcard again, scheduling another wrapper run whose job condition rejects it. Each upstream failure generates a chain of empty Actions runs that consume runner minutes and clutter the Actions tab. The PR description mentions "each finished workflow in a consumer therefore leaves a skipped wrapper run in the Actions tab" but does not call out that the wrapper's own completions also leave skipped runs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
